fee_normalisation.note: research EV is reported with the 100-lot canonical fee; 1-lot sensitivity kept in cfb_audit.json recompute_buy_every_side_at_ask

overtime.rule: Kalshi CFB rule text is not archived in the research corpus; scores used are ESPN finals INCLUDING overtime, and every OT-game ticker that also has an exchange-reported wager result agrees (see wager_settlement_crosscheck, ot subset below)

rescheduled_kickoff.resolution: rows are point-in-time valid iff captured_at < the kickoff in force at capture AND < the earliest kickoff ever recorded for the game; cfb_incremental uses the per-row kickoff, audit_cfb flagged the game. Count of rows violating the EARLIEST kickoff is rows_captured_after_the_earlier_kickoff.

wager_settlement_crosscheck.meaning: exchange-reported results exist ONLY for tickers SIFT actually wagered (a selected subset): they verify derivation rules, they are not a universe-wide official settlement
